Input hatches and input busses have learned to help themselves: a screwdriver's normal right-click orthogonal-cycles through the four states of input filter × auto-input, while a bus's Shift right-click keeps the original modes — just the old sort-and-limit pair.

Two speeds on the dial: fluid hatches pull 1,000 mB every 5 seconds, item busses move 1 stack every 5 seconds — all fed from the container right in front.

§8§oThe machines reach out for themselves; you just manage.§r
